top_signals.title: Orcel Sees New Commerzbank Governance as Early as Q1
top_signals.summary: UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel discusses the bank’s record quarterly profit and plans to take control of Germany's Commerzbank. Speaking to Bloomberg, Orcel says governance arrangements including a revamp of Commerzbank's supervisory board is coming early next year. (Source: Bloomberg)
